question: Identify the state abbreviations where, for both male and female legislators, the retention rate remains greater than zero at specific intervals of 0, 2, 4, 6, 8, and 10 years after their first term start date. A legislator is considered retained if they are serving on December 31 of the respective year. Only include states where both gender cohorts maintain non-zero retention rates at all six of these time points during the first decade of service.
sql:
WITH first_terms AS (
    SELECT 
        l.id_bioguide,
        l.gender,
        lt.state,
        CAST(strftime('%Y', CAST(lt.term_start AS DATE)) AS INTEGER) AS start_year
    FROM legislators l
    JOIN legislators_terms lt ON l.id_bioguide = lt.id_bioguide
    WHERE lt.term_number = 0
),
years_to_check AS (
    SELECT id_bioguide, gender, state, start_year + 0 AS check_year FROM first_terms
    UNION ALL
    SELECT id_bioguide, gender, state, start_year + 2 AS check_year FROM first_terms
    UNION ALL
    SELECT id_bioguide, gender, state, start_year + 4 AS check_year FROM first_terms
    UNION ALL
    SELECT id_bioguide, gender, state, start_year + 6 AS check_year FROM first_terms
    UNION ALL
    SELECT id_bioguide, gender, state, start_year + 8 AS check_year FROM first_terms
    UNION ALL
    SELECT id_bioguide, gender, state, start_year + 10 AS check_year FROM first_terms
),
retained AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        ytc.id_bioguide,
        ytc.gender,
        ytc.state,
        ytc.check_year,
        CASE WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM legislators_terms lt
            WHERE lt.id_bioguide = ytc.id_bioguide
            AND CAST(lt.term_start AS DATE) <= date(ytc.check_year || '-12-31')
            AND CAST(lt.term_end AS DATE) >= date(ytc.check_year || '-12-31')
        ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_retained
    FROM years_to_check ytc
),
retention_by_state_gender AS (
    SELECT 
        state,
        gender,
        check_year,
        COUNT(DISTINCT id_bioguide) AS count_retained
    FROM retained
    WHERE is_retained = 1
    GROUP BY state, gender, check_year
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT id_bioguide) > 0
),
state_gender_years AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT state, gender
    FROM retention_by_state_gender
),
males AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT state
    FROM retention_by_state_gender
    WHERE gender = 'M'
),
females AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT state
    FROM retention_by_state_gender
    WHERE gender = 'F'
)
SELECT m.state
FROM males m
INNER JOIN females f ON m.state = f.state
ORDER BY m.state
